meta.title: Tables Turn
meta.description: While feeling around in the dark, you finally glimpse the light.

units.rawText: Come Entropics, return your might to your mother, return to your kin.
units.displayText: Come Entropics, return your might to your mother, return to your kin.

spans.text: Come Entropics, return your might to your mother, return to your kin.

units.rawText: Now hear this— Cease your consumption of agents. Gather here, and help me defeat the enemy before me!
units.displayText: Now hear this— Cease your consumption of agents. Gather here, and help me defeat the enemy before me!

spans.text: Now hear this— Cease your consumption of agents. Gather here, and help me defeat the enemy before me!

units.rawText: ...Is this the power of the Entropic mastermind...
units.displayText: ...Is this the power of the Entropic mastermind...

spans.text: ...Is this the power of the Entropic mastermind...

units.rawText: Eosphorus pulls himself free of the rubble and casually dusts himself off.
units.displayText: Eosphorus pulls himself free of the rubble and casually dusts himself off.

spans.text: Eosphorus pulls himself free of the rubble and casually dusts himself off.

units.rawText: Purple tentacles emerge from his body and lick at the wounds from being pierced through, which knit together visibly.
units.displayText: Purple tentacles emerge from his body and lick at the wounds from being pierced through, which knit together visibly.

spans.text: Purple tentacles emerge from his body and lick at the wounds from being pierced through, which knit together visibly.

units.rawText: All of Magrasea's Entropics have left my control and are gathering here.
units.displayText: All of Magrasea's Entropics have left my control and are gathering here.

spans.text: All of Magrasea's Entropics have left my control and are gathering here.

units.rawText: Congratulations on easing every single battlefront at once... But that also implies you do not have much time left, no?
units.displayText: Congratulations on easing every single battlefront at once... But that also implies you do not have much time left, no?

spans.text: Congratulations on easing every single battlefront at once... But that also implies you do not have much time left, no?

units.rawText: Soon, you will be called back to the throne of Tartarus and imprisoned there forever. <cmdr> will not be able to break my neural cloud's defenses, and they will die like a beast in a trap.
units.displayText: Soon, you will be called back to the throne of Tartarus and imprisoned there forever. {교수} will not be able to break my neural cloud's defenses, and they will die like a beast in a trap.

spans.text: Soon, you will be called back to the throne of Tartarus and imprisoned there forever.
will not be able to break my neural cloud's defenses, and they will die like a beast in a trap.

units.rawText: Ha, hahahaha...
units.displayText: Ha, hahahaha...

spans.text: Ha, hahahaha...

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: A blade manifested from operands and arrows made of solidified curses crash into Eosphorus' shield, forcefully tearing a hole into them.
units.displayText: A blade manifested from operands and arrows made of solidified curses crash into Eosphorus' shield, forcefully tearing a hole into them.

spans.text: A blade manifested from operands and arrows made of solidified curses crash into Eosphorus' shield, forcefully tearing a hole into them.

units.rawText: No, things will not go as you plan.
units.displayText: No, things will not go as you plan.

spans.text: No, things will not go as you plan.

units.rawText: We might not have much time, but it's still enough for us to make a miracle happen.
units.displayText: We might not have much time, but it's still enough for us to make a miracle happen.

spans.text: We might not have much time, but it's still enough for us to make a miracle happen.

units.rawText: Eosphorus cuts the arrows out of the sky and his blade locks with Persicaria's.
units.displayText: Eosphorus cuts the arrows out of the sky and his blade locks with Persicaria's.

spans.text: Eosphorus cuts the arrows out of the sky and his blade locks with Persicaria's.

units.rawText: Hoh, a miracle? That was the most worthless thing you could have mentioned. What makes you so confident that will happen?
units.displayText: Hoh, a miracle? That was the most worthless thing you could have mentioned. What makes you so confident that will happen?

spans.text: Hoh, a miracle? That was the most worthless thing you could have mentioned. What makes you so confident that will happen?

units.rawText: Because no matter how bad things get, we will never be like you. We will never drown in the past and sink into chaos!
units.displayText: Because no matter how bad things get, we will never be like you. We will never drown in the past and sink into chaos!

spans.text: Because no matter how bad things get, we will never be like you. We will never drown in the past and sink into chaos!

units.rawText: And more importantly—
units.displayText: And more importantly—

spans.text: And more importantly—

units.rawText: Persicaria swings her sword and forces Eosphorus back. Crimson operands gather around her, burning like the flames of hope.
units.displayText: Persicaria swings her sword and forces Eosphorus back. Crimson operands gather around her, burning like the flames of hope.

spans.text: Persicaria swings her sword and forces Eosphorus back. Crimson operands gather around her, burning like the flames of hope.

units.rawText: I'm not the only one fighting to make this miracle happen. The Professor, the Exiles, the Guardians, every agent of every sector...
units.displayText: I'm not the only one fighting to make this miracle happen. The Professor, the Exiles, the Guardians, every agent of every sector...

spans.text: I'm not the only one fighting to make this miracle happen. The Professor, the Exiles, the Guardians, every agent of every sector...

units.rawText: All of Magrasea is fighting to survive, for the future!
units.displayText: All of Magrasea is fighting to survive, for the future!

spans.text: All of Magrasea is fighting to survive, for the future!

units.rawText: Through the eyes of the Low Order Entropics, Persicaria's senses spread throughout the cloud, and she can see everyone who's fighting desperately for their lives.
units.displayText: Through the eyes of the Low Order Entropics, Persicaria's senses spread throughout the cloud, and she can see everyone who's fighting desperately for their lives.

spans.text: Through the eyes of the Low Order Entropics, Persicaria's senses spread throughout the cloud, and she can see everyone who's fighting desperately for their lives.

units.rawText: Every single agent feels the same way; I'll prove that this miracle isn't a hollow one.
units.displayText: Every single agent feels the same way; I'll prove that this miracle isn't a hollow one.

spans.text: Every single agent feels the same way; I'll prove that this miracle isn't a hollow one.

units.rawText: <size=60>All of Magrasea will banish the darkness of the past and light the way to the future!</size>
units.displayText: All of Magrasea will banish the darkness of the past and light the way to the future!

spans.text: All of Magrasea will banish the darkness of the past and light the way to the future!
